scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.test:unit: node scripts/ensure-node.js && npm run test:unit --prefix backend && npm run test:unit --prefix frontend
scripts.test:coverage: node scripts/ensure-node.js && npm run test:coverage --prefix backend && npm run test:coverage --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: npm run prepare:local && docker compose up -d mongodb && wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:27017 && concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
scripts.docker:build: docker compose build mongodb backend frontend
scripts.docker:up: docker compose up -d mongodb backend frontend
scripts.docker:logs: docker compose logs -f backend frontend mongodb
scripts.docker:test: docker compose --profile test build backend-test frontend-test && docker compose --profile test run --rm backend-test && docker compose --profile test run --rm frontend-test
scripts.docker:dev: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build backend-dev mongodb
scripts.docker:run: npm run docker:build && npm run docker:up
